description: Stage-1 SWELL model: person-centred keystroke measures -> person-centred, SD-scaled MentalEffort / Stress (ridge, alpha=1). Trained on all SWELL people; hold-out scores are leave-one-person-out.

features.rate: log(keys per minute) over the person-condition block, minutes with >=20 keys

centring: subtract the person's own mean over their N, I and T blocks, then divide by the pooled within-person SD below
